title: Displacement general solutions in strain gradient elasticity: review and analysis
summary: In this work, we provide an overview of general solutions for displacement fields in static problems of isotropic strain gradient elasticity (SGE). We not only review existing solutions but also derive new representations, showing that all classical elasticity solutions - including those of Boussinesq-Galerkin, Papkovich-Neuber, Naghdi, Lame, Love and Boussinesq - can be simply generalized to SGE framework. In general, it is shown that SGE enables the use of any classical general solution representation combined with a Helmholtz decomposition for the gradient part of the displacement field.…
